The last 12 months do not yet have a full 12-month future, so their target is unknown. They are excluded from model fitting/evaluation but kept for the 'signal today' reading.

Months already IN a recession are excluded from fitting and scoring. The decision is made during expansions; inside a recession the target is trivially 1 while the curve has re-steepened (rate cuts), which teaches the model the opposite relationship. First attempt kept them: in-sample pseudo-R2 was about 0.05 and out-of-sample skill was negative (kept as results *_all_months).
